text: No, the sources do not agree on tree-cover loss in 2012. Hansen/UMD detected 1.4 ha of loss, but JRC 2020 only confirmed ~0.7 ha (49%). Since the corroboration rule requires ≥50% agreement, the claim is contradicted. MGAP’s 2021 map shows no native forest loss, with any change likely in planted forests (Pinus spp.). The sources do not establish whether loss occurred, its cause, or if it constitutes deforestation. Observability is high (Hansen data valid, 30m resolution), but the disagreement between Hansen and JRC means the evidence is inconclusive.
